jobs.occupation: Head of Planning - Forecasting, Demand & Ordering (m/f/d) (Master of Business Administration)
jobs.description:
#BEcomeMAXXYou’re passionate about data, numbers, and logic rather than gut feeling? You think analytically, love clear structures, and want to take full ownership of one of the most critical decision areas in the company? Then this role is for you.
As Head of Forecasting, you are the single analytical authority for all sales and demand forecasts at IronMaxx. You define the logic, methodology, and quality of the forecast end-to-end. With you, the forecast stands or falls.
Demand Planning is part of your responsibility – derived from the forecast and deliberately kept lean and standardized. Your focus is not operational complexity, but forecast accuracy, transparency, and reliability as the foundation for all downstream decisions.
Ready to perform? Your tasks with MAXXimum focus Forecast Ownership & Analytical Excellence
• End-to-end responsibility for sales and demand forecasts across all channels and markets.
• Definition, continuous improvement, and enforcement of forecast logic and methodology as a single source of truth.
• Acting as the final decision-making authority for all forecast-related questions and adjustments.
• Establishment and ownership of a structured forecast cycle including reviews, adjustments, and decision gates.
• Deep analysis of forecast accuracy, bias, and deviations with clear corrective actions.

Demand Planning – derived & simplified
• Conceptual responsibility for Demand Planning as a direct and consistent derivation of the forecast.
• Reduction of complexity through standardization, clear rules, and transparent assumptions.
• Ensuring demand figures are plausible, explainable, and actionable for Supply Chain and Operations.
• Close alignment with Supply Chain, Procurement, and Production to translate forecasts into executable plans.

Data, Tools & Governance
• Methodological ownership of forecasting models, KPIs, and planning tools (e.g. SAP Business One, Streamline).
• Continuous improvement of data quality, transparency, and reproducibility.
• Development of scenarios, simulations, and what-if analyses to support management and financial decisions.
• Collaboration with Finance to align forecast, budget, and business cases.

Leadership & Cross-functional Alignment
• Functional and disciplinary leadership of the Planning & Ordering team with a strong analytical focus.
• Clear positioning of Sales, eCommerce, and Product Development as structured input providers, not forecast owners.
• Sparring partner for Management – fact-based, structured, and data-driven.
• Responsibility for relevant KPIs, performance monitoring, and reporting.

Your skillset - as strong as our protein
• Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Data Analytics, or a comparable field.
• Several years of experience in Forecasting / Sales Forecasting / Demand Forecasting (ideally FMCG: Food and E-Commerce).
• Proven ownership of forecast quality, logic, and methodology.
• Strong analytical mindset and ownership responsibility
• Excellent command of ERP and forecasting tools (e.g. SAP Business One, Streamline) and advanced Excel skills.
• Leadership experience with a structured, clarity-driven management style.
• Very good English skills, German Skills are a plus

About us Quality & Innovations from IronMaxx® Nutrition
Premium sports nutrition - Designed in Germany!
Producing the best sports nutrition worldwide is the goal of IronMaxx®.

The production of highly efficient sports nutrition of the best quality and the constant further development of our products led to the award of the State Prize for Excellent Food Quality by the State of North Rhine-Westphalia. However, this is no reason for us to rest on our laurels - we are constantly working with the greatest passion to offer you supplements that inspire, work and taste great! The integration of the latest study results and the evaluation of practical field research in cooperation with professional sports clubs and our customers have led to permanent innovation in the development of new sports and fitness nutrition at IronMaxx® Nutrition since the company was founded in 2004.

In addition to the basics of sports nutrition in the areas of strength/endurance, muscle building and diet , this includes effective nutritional supplements for health and prevention , intelligent new combinations of active ingredients and improved dosage forms, such as our Tricaps® .

In the area of protein products, for example, IronMaxx® has set a milestone in the evolution of the latest sports nutrition products with the development of water-based protein powders in over 31 flavors. The sweet spread with the world's highest protein content , IronMaxx® Protein Creme, also comes from us.

Designed in Germany - as a German sports nutrition manufacturer, IronMaxx® is also committed to outstanding quality and seamless quality control.

High performance - the goal is the goal.

Well-known professional clubs, such as the eight-time German ice hockey champions, the "Kölner Haie", or the traditional handball club VfL Gummersbach with its unique success story, have relied for years on the efficient sports nutrition from IronMaxx® and on our expertise in the use and mode of action of nutritional supplements.

While in many areas of life the "path is often proclaimed as the goal", our customers usually have a very clear idea of their "dream body" and its desired performance. This passion to achieve their personal goa l is something we share with all our partners and customers - be it an athletic body, achieving new personal bests, reducing body weight or achieving sporting team success.

IronMaxx® products have therefore become an integral part of the product range of many European fitness studios, wholesalers, pharmacies and body stores in recent years due to their high quality.

#BEcomeMAXXYou enjoy turning forecasts into reality? You like structure, numbers, and processes — but you’re equally strong in leading people, creating clarity, and keeping teams aligned? Then this role is made for you.
As Senior Demand Planning Manager, you own the operational and tactical Demand Planning at IronMaxx. You translate centrally defined forecasts into stable demand, inventory, and ordering decisions, lead your team with clarity and empathy, and act as a close sparring partner to the Head of Forecasting.
While the final ownership of the forecast lies with the Head of Forecasting, you ensure that forecasts work in reality — operationally sound, executable, and stable across the supply chain.
Ready to perform? Your tasks with MAXXimum focus Demand Planning Ownership
• End-to-end responsibility for operational and tactical demand planning, derived from the central forecast.
• Ensuring high product availability, stable inventory levels, and efficient replenishment.
• Creation, maintenance, and validation of demand, inventory, and ordering plans.
• Continuous monitoring of stock levels, safety stock, lead times, and sales performance.
• Early identification of risks such as shortages, overstocks, or supply bottlenecks.

Buying & Supplier Coordination
• Close operational collaboration with Purchasing and suppliers regarding orders, quantities, and delivery schedules.
• Tracking delivery dates, production status, and proactive escalation of delays or risks.
• Ensuring a smooth and reliable flow of goods across the supply chain.

Sparring & Cross-functional Collaboration
• Acting as a key sparring partner to the Head of Forecasting, providing operational feedback and plausibility checks on forecasts.
• Close alignment with Sales, Customer Success, Logistics, Production, and Procurement.
• Translating strategic forecast assumptions into executable operational actions.

Processes, Tools & Continuous Improvement
• Hands-on use and further development of demand planning and ERP tools (e.g. SAP Business One, Streamline).
• Identification and implementation of operational improvements in demand planning, replenishment, and buying processes.
• Contribution to scenario analyses, data evaluations, and cross-functional process optimization projects.

Your skillset - as strong as our protein
• Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, or a comparable qualification.
• Several years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain, Purchasing, or related fields, ideally with leadership responsibility.
• Strong analytical and structured mindset with high numerical affinity.
• Proven experience in leading teams (disciplinary and/or functional).
• Strong people skills: clear, empathetic, reliable, and collaborative
• Confident handling of ERP and demand planning tools (e.g. SAP, Streamline).
• Solution-oriented, hands-on, and execution-driven working style.
• Very good English skills, German skills are mandatory

jobs.occupation: Research Associate / PhD Student / PostDoc (m/f/x) Multidimensional Optical Information Processing (Physiker/in)
jobs.description:
TUD Dresden University of Technology, as a University of Excellence, is one of the leading and most dynamic research institutions in the country. Accordingly, we welcome all applicants who would like to commit themselves, their achievements and productivity to the success of the whole institution.

At the Faculty of Electrical and Computer Engineering, Institute of Circuits and Systems, the Chair of Measurement and Sensor System Techniques (MST) offers a position as

Research Associate / PhD Student / PostDoc (m/f/x)

Multidimensional Optical Information Processing
(subject to personal qualification, employees are remunerated according to salary group E 13 TV-L)

within the Reinhart-Koselleck project award starting as soon as possible. The position is limited to 3 years. The period of employment is governed by the Fixed Term Research Contracts Act (Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetz - WissZeitVG). The position comprises up to 100% of the fulltime weekly hours. Balancing family and career is an important issue. The position is generally suitable for candidates seeking part-time employment. Please indicate your request in your application. The position offers the chance to obtain further academic qualification (usually PhD / habilitation thesis).

Tasks:

Programmable optical diffractive neural networks are inspired by the principles of biological neural networks; while they are trained using GPU-based optimization methods, the actual information processing takes place without a GPU, making them energy-efficient and fast. Diffractive networks are to be designed using novel, ultra-fast phase modulators to process high-dimensional structured light carrying orbital angular momentum. MEMS phase modulators should be investigated for optical routers and multiplexers. By using multiple wavelengths and spatial modes in multimode fibers for the Internet of Things and the quantum internet new paradigms will be studied.

Your responsibilities include:

- experimental and simulation-based investigations of optical diffractive neural networks based on MEMS-Phase Light Modulator
- application of the of the diffractive neural network with multimode fibers for novel routers and multiplexers 
- publication of research results in international scientific journals, filing of patents, and presentation of conference contributions; the position can be flexibly tailored to focus on experimental laboratory work or simulation-based studies

Requirements: 

- above-average university degree in the subject physics, information systems technique, electrical engineering, or related areas
- ability and willingness to work independently and conceptually in a team, in a goal-oriented manner, with a high level of commitment 
- excellent written and spoken German and English skills
- interest in practice-oriented, interdisciplinary collaboration with international cooperation partners from research and industry
- knowledge of software development, deep learning, computational imaging, Fourier optics
- previous knowledge of quantum optics, waveguide optics, multiplane light conversion, MATLAB or Python is advantageous

We offer: 

- a diverse, cutting-edge and challenging research position with your own externally funded research project, dedicated funding and opportunities to shape and develop your research 
- an interdisciplinary research group whose pioneering paradigm shifts have been recognized with prestigious awards like Bertha Benz Prize of Daimler Benz Foundation, Körber Prize, Gabor award of Optica and Fraunhofer award of SPIE; the Czarske Lab has delivered more than 100 invited talks on all continents in recent years
- 9 excellent laboratories and research facilities 
- opportunities to publish in high-quality scientific journals and attend international conferences for scientific exchange; excellent connections with research and industry partners 
- flexible working hours; participation in the supplementary public-sector pension scheme through VBL

TUD strives to employ more women in academia and research. We therefore expressly encourage women to apply. The university is a family-friendly university. We welcome applications from candidates with disabilities. If multiple candidates prove to be equally qualified, those with disabilities or with equivalent status pursuant to the German Social Code IX (SGB IX) will receive priority for employment.

Application:

Please submit your detailed application with the usual documents by October 15, 2026 (stamped arrival date of the university central mail service or the time stamp on the email server of TUD applies), by sending it as a single pdf file to grp-application-mst@msx.tu-dresden.de (https://mailto:grp-application-mst@msx.tu-dresden.de)  (Please note: We are currently not able to receive electronically signed and encrypted data) or to:

TU Dresden, Chair of Measurement and Sensor System Technique, Prof. Juergen Czarske, Helmholtzstr. 10, 01069 Dresden, Germany.

Please submit copies only, as your application will not be returned to you. Expenses incurred in attending interviews cannot be reimbursed.

TUD is a founding partner in the DRESDEN-concept alliance.

Reference to data protection: Your data protection rights, the purpose for which your data will be processed, as well as further information about data protection is available to you on the website: https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis (https://tu-dresden.de/karriere/datenschutzhinweis) .

The foundation Max-Planck-Institut für Kohlenforschung in Mülheim an der Ruhr is a renowned research institution that is over 100 years old and has already received two Nobel Prizes in its history. The institute is engaged in basic research in the field of catalysis with the aim of maximizing the efficient use of natural resources.

As a part of the Cluster of Excellence RESOLV (Ruhr Explores Solvation), the Early Career research group “Catalysis” of Dr. Hanna Hinrika Cramer develops organometallic catalysts with earth-abundant first-row transition metals. The team combines experiments, quantum chemistry, and spectroscopy to study reaction mechanisms and to discover how solvation and catalyst design affect the rate and selectivity. Current projects focus on developing well-defined chromium precatalysts for applications in olefin upgrading and the activation of strong bonds. 

The Cramer group invites applications for a

PhD Student in Organometallic Catalysis 

(full-time, with 39 hours)

Job description: 

- the synthesis and characterization of organometallic complexes
- the development of catalytic applications
- and quantum chemical calculations on electronic structures and reaction mechanisms

Qualifications:

- a Master’s degree in chemistry or a related field
- basic knowledge and research experience in molecular inorganic chemistry, coordination chemistry, catalysis, and/or reaction mechanisms
- excellent oral and written communication skills in English
- intrinsic motivation and curiosity about organometallic catalysis and sustainable chemistry

Job offer: The position is funded for three years and located at Ruhr University Bochum (RUB). Students will participate in the integrated Graduate School Solvation Science (iGSS) including a three-month international research stay, industrial internship, or entrepreneurship training. As part of RESOLV, the group has access to state-of-the-art infrastructure and collaborations with partners at RUB and at the Max Planck Institute für Kohlenforschung. Group members will therefore have the chance to learn highly diverse techniques, depending on their research focus and interest.

Applications: Please send your application package including a motivation letter, CV, and transcript of records to Dr. Hanna Hinrika Cramer (hanna.cramer@rub.de (https://mailto:hanna.cramer@rub.de) ) by October 23, 2026. Further information about the position can be requested by email.  Applications will be considered on a rolling basis. The earliest possible starting date is January 01, 2027, but the exact date is flexible.

The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Severely disabled applicants will be given priority if equally qualified. We ask for your understanding that submitted application documents will not be returned.

The information on the collection of personal  data in accordance with Art. 13 GDPR can be found on our homepage under https://www.kofo.mpg.de/863307/200609_Datenschutz_Bewerbung_engGB.pdf (https://www.kofo.mpg.de/863307/200609_Datenschutz_Bewerbung_engGB.pdf)

As an R&D Quality Auditor (m/f/d), you will provide essential quality and consultative support and oversight for animal health development activities supporting global projects. You will partner closely with Elanco R&D teams to drive compliance by implementing and monitoring Elanco Quality Standards, training, and compliance tools, ensuring GxP (Good Practice) adherence.

Your Responsibilities

- Provide Quality oversight to all functions within R&D and for assigned global projects, developing strong partnerships with stakeholders to proactively offer quality input and assist with risk assessments.
- Plan and conduct GxP oversight activities, including GRP (Good Research Practice), GCP (Good Clinical Practice), or GLP (Good Laboratory Practice) study protocol, in-life, and data/reports reviews/audits, as well as site process self-inspections.
- Review local and global procedures (Standard Operating Procedures - SOPs and Elanco Functional Procedures - EFPs) to ensure compliance with Elanco Quality Standards and Policies and relevant regulatory requirements.
- Provide quality and compliance training to R&D personnel, developing training presentations on GxP or compliance topics as needed.
- Maintain Quality Agreements with third parties for development activities and support Elanco Global Quality Compliance and Auditing (EGQCA) audits at third-party organizations.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications)

- Degree in Science (MSc, B.Pharm/M.Pharm, Postgraduate in Vet Sciences, or equivalent).
- A minimum of 5 years of experience in auditing in animal health studies.
- Demonstrated extensive experience in providing Quality Assurance oversight or Monitoring of veterinary clinical studies in support of regulatory submissions.
- Knowledge in at least one of the following: GCP (VICH GL9) or OECD GLP.
- Fluency in English (written and oral).
- Good German or another EU language such as Spanish or Portuguese skills.
- Ability to make decisions when there is no clear right or wrong answer.
- Experience in the creation and/or revision of relevant Quality procedures and driving the rollout of quality processes for a site.

Your Benefits

- Employer subsidised pension scheme
- 40 hours / week
- 30 days holiday + opportunity to earn more time off
- Active BGM and health care
- Subsidy for the Deutschlandticket and bicycle leasing
- Meal allowance in the canteens
- Scope for personal initiative and opportunities for individual further training
- Work in a dynamic team in an international company

Additional Information: Travel within Europe: 40-60%, Location: Monheim (Germany)

The ScopeWe are looking for an engaged Policy Manager, Technology Solutions who brings solid expertise and a passion for FSC’s mission, to work with us in a multinational environment.

The Policy Manager, Technology Solutions is responsible for identifying, developing, implementing, and managing digital solutions that enhance the efficiency, accessibility, and effectiveness of Country Requirements processes. The role serves as a bridge between policy and technical teams, leading digital transformation initiatives, managing technology projects, and ensuring that digital tools and systems support the development and maintenance of FSC Risk Assessments, Forest Stewardship Standards, and related normative frameworks.

The position requires strong project leadership, business analysis, stakeholder engagement, and technology management skills to drive innovation and continuous improvement across the Country Requirements function.
Main Roles & Responsibilities
• Lead the identification, development, procurement, and implementation of digital tools and technology solutions that support Country Requirements processes.
• Serve as project lead for the development and enhancement of Country Requirements databases and related information management systems.
• Act as Product Owner for the FSC Risk Hub, driving platform improvements, user experience enhancements, and publication of Risk Assessments.
• Manage external consultants, vendors, and technical partners involved in digital tool development and digitalization projects.
• Oversee the maintenance, monitoring, quality assurance, and continuous improvement of digital tools, databases, and reporting systems.
• Support the drafting, review, maintenance, and digitalization of normative documents, guidance materials, and standard operating procedures (SoPs).
• Facilitate collaboration between policy experts, standards specialists, software developers, and IT teams to translate business needs into effective digital solutions.
• Support procurement processes, project budgets, funding streams, and operational planning related to Risk Assessments and Forest Stewardship Standards.
• Plan, facilitate, and report on meetings, webinars, training sessions, and stakeholder engagement activities.
• Drive innovation within the Policy Solutions team by identifying opportunities for automation, data management, reporting, and process optimization.

Your profile
• University degree in Public Administration, Non-profit Management, Business Administration, Forest Management, Forest Policy, Environmental Science, Quality Management, or a related field.
• At least 5 years of professional experience in certification systems, quality management, forestry, natural resource management, public administration, non-profit management, or a related area.
• Proven experience leading digital transformation initiatives, technology projects, or business process improvement activities.
• Strong ability to translate business requirements into digital solutions and communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics, Power BI, Microsoft 365, databases, dashboards, and enterprise digital tools.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, project management, and stakeholder management skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities independently while maintaining alignment with cross-functional teams and leadership.
• Excellent written communication skills with experience drafting procedures, reports, guidance documents, and other formal documentation.
• Experience with digitalization of standards, policy frameworks, or normative documents is highly desirable; GIS experience is an advantage.
• Fluent in English; French is considered an asset.

Why us?
• Benefit from cross-cultural collaboration and networking opportunities by being part of FSC global community of 400+ forest stewards
• Benefit from work-life balance with our hybrid working structure
• 30 vacation days yearly
• Regional transportation ticket
• Breakfast bars, coffee, tea, water
• Take part in learning lunches
• Celebrate together festivals from different cultures

The Fine Print
• Location: Bonn, Germany.
• Working Hours: Full time - 40 hours per week.
• Duration of Employment: Temporary contract - 2 years (extension possible, subject to satisfactory performance).
• Starting Date: As soon as possible.

How to Apply
Ready to make a difference? Join FSC and help shape a sustainable future. Don't delay - apply now!
• Please apply via our website by submitting your CV in English.
• Please do not send any photos of yourself.
• Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

For FSC, inclusiveness and diversity are important values. As such, we welcome and encourage applications from all backgrounds and are entirely committed to consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age and disability.

We will confirm receipt of your application. Should you not receive a confirmation of receipt please check your spam filter and if you cannot find it there contact us at careers@fsc.org

Please be informed, that by applying for this position you automatically accept our Data Protection Information on processing your personal data.

We are looking forward to your application!

About us Welcome to FSC!

The Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) is a globally recognized non-profit organization at the forefront of promoting sustainable forestry. With over 150 million hectares of certified forests and a trusted reputation among NGOs, consumers, and businesses, FSC is leading the way in ensuring the long-term health and resilience of the world’s forests.

Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Institute for Pharmacology and Toxicology
Ref.-Nr.  601-2026
Third-party funding

The Faculty of Medicine is an integral part of the Otto-von-Guericke-University Magdeburg and cooperates with the Magdeburg University Hospital A.ö.R. in research, teaching and patient care.

Your Responsibilities:

We are seeking two highly motivated Postdoctoral Research Fellows to join our team investigating the molecular and cellular organization of the nervous system using cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics approaches. The successful candidates will work at the interface of neuroscience, genomics, and computational biology to map gene expression patterns across brain tissue with spatial resolution, contributing to our understanding of neural circuit organization, development, and disease.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative, well-resourced research environment with access to state-of-the-art spatial profiling platforms (e.g., MERFISH, 10x Visium), advanced microscopy, and high-performance computing infrastructure.

Two positions are available with complementary focus:

- Position 1 — Experimental/Wet-lab focus: Designing and executing spatial transcriptomics experiments on neural tissue, including tissue preparation, probe design, imaging, and data generation
- Position 2 — Computational/Analytical focus: Developing and applying computational pipelines for spatial transcriptomic data analysis, including cell-type mapping, spatial statistics, and integration with single-cell/single-nucleus datasets

(Candidates with strong interest and skills spanning both areas are also encouraged to apply and may be considered for either position.)

Key Responsibilities:

- Design, plan, and conduct spatial transcriptomics experiments on neural tissue samples
- Analyze and interpret complex spatial and single-cell genomic datasets
- Collaborate with neuroscientists, computational biologists, and clinicians within and outside the group
- Present findings at lab meetings, seminars, and international conferences
- Prepare manuscripts for peer-reviewed publication
- Contribute to grant writing and mentoring of graduate/undergraduate students
- Maintain rigorous documentation and adhere to good research and data management practices

Your Profile:

Essential Qualifications:

- A PhD (completed or close to completion) in Neuroscience, Molecular/Cell Biology, Genomics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, or a related field
- Demonstrated research productivity (peer-reviewed publications and/or preprints)
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

For the experimental-focus position, in addition:

- Hands-on experience with molecular biology techniques (e.g., histology, immunohistochemistry, in situ hybridization, RNA-seq library prep)
- Experience with spatial transcriptomics platforms (e.g., Visium, MERFISH, Xenium, seqFISH) is highly desirable
- Experience with rodent or human brain tissue handling is a plus

For the computational-focus position, in addition:

- Strong programming skills (Python and/or R)
- Experience analyzing single-cell/single-nucleus RNA-seq or spatial transcriptomics data
- Familiarity with relevant packages/tools (e.g., Scanpy, Seurat, Squidpy, STUtility) and statistical/machine learning methods
- Experience with high-performance/cluster computing is a plus

We offer:

- Access to cutting-edge spatial transcriptomics and imaging technology
- A collaborative, interdisciplinary, and supportive research environment
- Funding and support to attend international conferences
- Opportunities for career development, mentoring, and grant-writing training
- Work and family in harmony: Through Klinikzwerge (https://kita.med.ovgu.de/) , childcare may be available, subject to availability
- Help protect the environment and enjoy discounted public transportation through a job ticket
- In addition, we offer a diverse range of sports and relaxation activities as part of our workplace health promotion program
- Onboarding: At the start of your employment, you will participate in our orientation program, where you will receive important information and training sessions

Terms and Conditions:

- **Salary: **The salary group E 13 according to “Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst der Länder” awaits you
- **Appointment: **The position is to be filled as a full-time position, with a workload of 2,5 years, starting on 2027/01/01
- Work Location: Otto-von-Guericke-Universität Magdeburg, Medizinische Fakultät, Leipziger Str. 44, 39120 Magdeburg

For further questions, please contact Mrs. Dr. Julia Rödiger at julia.roediger@med.ovgu.de

jobs.occupation: Compliance Officer Awareness und Prevention (m/w/d) - Essen (GER) or Madrid (SP) (Compliance-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Company

Through its Rothe Erde, Uhde and Polysius businesses as well as the majority investment thyssenkrupp nucera, Decarbon Technologies delivers innovative, cutting-edge technologies for the transition to a climate-neutral industrial economy. Rothe Erde is a leading provider of bearings and solutions that play a key role in wind, solar and tidal power plants, among other things. With its solutions for decarbonization, defossilization and the circular economy, Uhde is a technology and implementation provider of large-scale plants for the chemical industry. Polysius supplies green technologies for the cement and lime industry, digital automation solutions, and on-site and remote maintenance services. thyssenkrupp nucera is a global supplier of electrolysis technology for the industrial-scale production of clean hydrogen. The segment employs around 12,000 people, who generated revenues of approximately 3.8 billion euros in fiscal year 2023/2024.

Your responsibilities

- You will actively contribute to the further development and effective implementation of the Compliance Management System within the Decarbon Technologies segment and take ownership of selected compliance areas, including anti-corruption, data compliance, anti-money laundering, and export control/trade compliance. A key focus of your role will be the provision of antitrust and competition law advice as well as the further development and implementation of competition law compliance measures.
- You will help ensure that segment-wide standards are adhered to, compliance risks are identified at an early stage, and regulatory requirements are implemented efficiently across the organization.
- As part of a holistic compliance approach, you will advise and support the business on additional compliance topics, particularly with regard to the German Supply Chain Due Diligence Act (LkSG) and related regulatory requirements.

jobs.description:
Key Facts at a glance:

- In your role as Process Engineer (all genders), you will be responsible for operating an AIXTRON CCS or Planetary system in our application laboratory.
- You will serve as the direct contact for the Simulation and Design departments regarding process
optimization and further development of reactor hardware.
- In addition, you will work closely with colleagues from Sales & Marketing and conduct system
demonstrations to support customer acquisition. You will also contribute to cooperation projects with internal and external partners.

In Detail

- As a process engineer in the AIXTRON application laboratory, you will actively and independently shape the development and optimization of our deposition reactors and processes for compound semiconductor deposition.
- Thanks to your independent and well-coordinated working style, you will plan and manage cross-departmental projects to further develop our deposition processes and drive the evaluation of hardware prototypes.
- Your fascination with technology and your pursuit of perfection will motivate you to design and coordinate sometimes complex test series within development projects.
- Turning data into information: With your structured and scientific-analytical approach, you will recognize complex relationships and draw conclusions from experimental series.
- As a multiplier of our know-how, you will carefully analyze and document the knowledge and experience gained and share it with colleagues and team members.
- You will be able to adapt processes developed in the laboratory to customer requirements and transfer them to customer systems, making a key contribution to ensuring our customers’ rapid success.

Your Profile

- You hold a degree in a scientific or technical field, e.g., Physics, Electrical Engineering, Chemistry, Materials Science, or a comparable qualification.
- During your studies and professional experience, you have developed solid expertise in CMOS technology, advanced material deposition, semiconductor processing, and solid-state physics. In addition, you possess in-depth knowledge of epitaxial growth processes for both Group III–V and Group IV materials, which you confidently apply in practice.
- You have process experience in semiconductor deposition, ideally using RPCVD on a commercial epitaxy system. Knowledge of other growth techniques such as MBE, ALD, or sputtering is also advantageous.
- You are experienced in handling various characterization methods and solid-state physics-related questions and have worked with measurement equipment.
- You have good written and spoken English skills.
- You are flexible and open to international travel (approximately 5–10%).

What you can expect from us

- Flexible working hours: No fixed core hours, mobile working options, and the ability to switch between office and mobile office.
- Vacation: 30 vacation days as standard, with the option to increase annually through salary conversion.
- Profit sharing: Opportunity to participate in the company’s success and benefit from profit sharing.
- Health: Promotion of your physical and mental health through regular health initiatives.
- Further development: Continuous development through the AIXTRON Academy and individual support programs.
- Retirement and additional insurance: Support for pension plans, capital-forming benefits, and additional insurance options.
- Catering: Subsidized meals in the company cafeteria and fresh seasonal fruit baskets.
- Open corporate culture: Open and respectful informal culture (“Duz”) across all hierarchy levels.
- Sustainability and mobility: E-charging stations for cars and bicycles, good public transport connections, and free parking.
- Employee referral program: Attractive rewards for referring new talent to AIXTRON.

jobs.description:
Unternehmen

thyssenkrupp nucera offers world-leading technologies for high-efficiency electrolysis plants. The company has extensive in-depth knowledge in the engineering, procurement, and construction of electrochemical plants and a strong track record of more than 600 projects with a total rating of over 10 gigawatts already successfully installed. With its water electrolysis technology to produce green hydrogen, the company offers an innovative solution on an industrial scale for green value chains and an industry fueled by clean energy – a major step towards a climate-neutrality.
www.thyssenkrupp-nucera.com

Aufgaben

You will be part of our global Automation organization and play a key role in the development, maintenance and continuous improvement of automation standards for electrolysis projects, including green hydrogen (AWE), chlor-alkali and HCl electrolysis technologies.
Your role involves assuming responsibility for defined engineering work packages to support parallel project execution and enhance delivery reliability and throughput as well as responsibility for complete automation scopes during various phases of project execution.
Your tasks:

- Acting as a technical lead for automation topics within projects executed by our global automation team
- Performing basic and detail engineering for control and safety systems, including architecture design, hardware planning and software concepts
- Supporting technical procurement, supplier clarification and evaluation of automation components and systems
- Preparing and supporting Factory Acceptance Tests, including coordination with suppliers and alignment within our global automation team
- Providing support for installation, commissioning, and troubleshooting activities for automation systems at construction sites worldwide, primarily through short-term assignments (remote and on-site, as required)
- Serving as a key technical interface within our global automation organization and other global stakeholders
- Ensuring compliance with internal standards, project-specific requirements, functional safety and IT/OT security guidelines
- Creating and reviewing technical documentation using database-based and engineering IT tools
- Actively sharing knowledge and best practices and mentoring junior engineers
- Contributing to the continuous improvement of our automation solutions
- Contribute to the development, maintenance and evolution of standardized automation solutions
- Drive modularization, reusability and productization of automation assets to support scalable and future-proof solutions

Profil

- Degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering or comparable technical discipline
- Several years of professional experience in automation engineering for industrial or process plants, preferably in chemical or electrolysis plant engineering
- Strong hands-on experience with industrial automation systems and hardware, including SAS and PLC platforms from leading manufacturers
- Strong understanding of automation system architectures
- Interest or experience in new automation technologies, digitalization, simulation or advanced engineering methods is an advantage
- Solid knowledge of network and fieldbus technologies (e.g. Profinet, Modbus TCP)
- Experience or strong understanding of functional safety and IT/OT security concepts in industrial environments
- Ability to work independently and structured, with a strong sense of ownership for technical results and quality
- Proven capability to work in international and intercultural teams
- Very good English und German communication skills, both written and verbal (min. C1)
- Willingness to travel internationally for short-term assignments
- Natural inclination to coach and support less experienced colleagues, acting as a role model within the team

Das bieten wir

As part of the thyssenkrupp group, we offer our employees high level conditions and many benefits:

- performance-related compensation according to collective agreement Metal und Electro NRW
- attractive old-age provision models
- groupwide learning measures
- thyssenkrupp Group health campaigns and programs
At thyssenkrupp nucera, we attach great importance to individual needs - to this end, we are constantly developing as an employer and offer a wide range of benefits for your perfect working-life-balance:
- In an environment characterized by flat hierarchies and a lot of personal responsibility, we create space for individual development.
- We offer further training and support in line with your individual strengths and goals in order to optimally accompany your career path.
- In intercultural and interdisciplinary teams, communication at eye level is our top priority.

- For the perfect office days, we provide state-of-the-art equipment at our global locations as well as quiet and communal areas for every situation.

- If that's not enough for you: by working on green hydrogen technologies, we are ensuring clean energy for the future. Be a part of it: new era is you.
